note: Surface tags describe material rather than road access or surveyed grades. Original geometry, width, classification and surface fields are preserved. Untagged / generic paved surfaces remain labelled defaults. Explicit existing photographic overrides take precedence. Texture colour, unit / joint dimensions, aggregate scale and every fine offset are reconstructed. Source stair sections retain special step meshes. Regional GIS / photo-built ground patches continue to override the underlying path ribbons.
